```yaml
name: E2E Portal Test 🧪

on:
  workflow_dispatch: ~
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  e2e_portal_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - name: ⚡ Setup Golang
      uses: actions/setup-go@v6
      with:
        go-version-file: go.mod
        cache: true

    - name: Setup Rust
      uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
      with:
        toolchain: '1.91.1'
        components: rustfmt, clippy

    - name: ⚡ Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'
        cache-dependency-path: tavern/internal/www/package-lock.json

    - name: 📦 Install System Dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler libssl-dev

    - name: 🔨 Build Tavern
      run: |
        go mod download
        go build -v -o tavern_bin ./tavern

    - name: 🚀 Run Tavern
      env:
        HTTP_LISTEN_ADDR: ":8000"
        SOCKS5_UDP_ENABLED: "true"
      run: |
        ./tavern_bin &
        echo "Waiting for Tavern to start..."
        # Wait for port 8000
        timeout 30 sh -c 'until nc -z $0 $1; do sleep 1; done' localhost 8000

    - name: 🤖 Run Agent
      working-directory: implants/imixv2
      env:
        IMIX_CALLBACK_URI: "http://localhost:8000"
        IMIX_CALLBACK_INTERVAL: 1
        IMIX_SOCKS5_PROXY: "localhost:1080"
      run: |
        # Fetch the pubkey and verify it's not empty
        PUBKEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8000/status | jq -r .Pubkey)
        if [ -z "$PUBKEY" ] || [ "$PUBKEY" == "null" ]; then
          echo "Error: Could not fetch Pubkey from Tavern"
          exit 1
        fi
        export IMIX_SERVER_PUBKEY=$PUBKEY
        echo "Got pubkey: $IMIX_SERVER_PUBKEY"

        echo "Building imixv2..."
        cargo build --bin imixv2 --target-dir ./build
        # Run agent and pipe logs to a file
        ./build/debug/imixv2 > agent.log 2>&1 &

        # Give the agent a moment to perform the initial handshake
        echo "Agent started. Waiting for initial callback..."
        sleep 5

    - name: 🎭 Install Playwright
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: |
        npm ci
        npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

    - name: 🧪 Run Playwright Tests
      working-directory: tests/e2e
      run: |
        npx playwright test

    - name: 📊 Collect Test Results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      if: always()
      with:
        name: Playwright Test Results
        path: tests/e2e/test-results/**/*.xml
        reporter: jest-junit

    - name: 🧪 Run Traffic Verification Script
      run: |
        # Verify SOCKS5 UDP support by running traffic verification script
        cd bin/imix_connect
        go run main.go --verify-udp-support --server=localhost:1080

    - name: 📋 Upload Logs
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: tavern-logs
        path: |
          tavern_bin
          agent.log
          tavern.log
        retention-days: 7

    - name: 🧹 Cleanup
      if: always()
      run: |
        pkill -f tavern_bin || true
        pkill -f imixv2 || true
```
